description: This file defines the DownloadableDatatypeHandler interface in the org.openmrs.customdatatype package. It specifies methods for handling downloadable custom data types, including retrieving content type, filename, and writing data to an output stream.

classes.name: DownloadableDatatypeHandler
classes.description: A Java interface for handling downloadable custom data types, extending the CustomDatatypeHandler interface with methods for content type, filename, and stream writing.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type for the custom value to be downloaded, given the datatype and value reference.

methods.name: getFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename to be used during download; may return null to allow default naming.

methods.name: writeToStream
methods.description: Writes the custom value to the provided OutputStream; used to stream the data for download.
